title: Google Patents - Search, Inventors, Assignees & 专利
description: Minimal working input: {"searchQueries": ["solar battery"], "country": ""}. Default maximum 20 paid patent rows; only delivered rows billed.

searchQueries.title: searchQueries
searchQueries.description: One or more keyword search strings, e.g. ["solar battery"]. One page budget per query. Results are deduplicated by id across queries before billing.

country.title: country
country.description: Patent publication office, e.g. "US" or "CN". Empty means all offices. Not inventor nationality. Free source filter plus output-prefix validation.

maxResults.title: maxResults
maxResults.description: Maximum paid rows across the entire run, after filters and exclusions. Example: 20. May return fewer when source pages end or maxPages is reached.

maxPages.title: maxPages
maxPages.description: Maximum source pages per target, 1–20; default 3. Up to 10 patent publications per source page per query. No publication-date filter is built in. Filters are free; maxResults can be lower than this scan budget.

includeKeywords.title: includeKeywords
includeKeywords.description: Case-insensitive OR substring filter on title and snippet. Example: ["battery"]. Empty [] disables it. Applied before billing inside the page budget; not a semantic classifier or additional source search.
includeKeywords.sectionCaption: Filters and repeat runs / 筛选与去重

excludeIds.title: excludeIds
excludeIds.description: Copy prior output id values here to skip before billing. id is the publication number, e.g. US12352469B2. Empty [] disables it. This also suppresses changes to existing IDs.

excludeContentHashes.title: excludeContentHashes
excludeContentHashes.description: SHA-256 content_hash values from previous output to skip unchanged snapshots before billing. Example: copy returned hashes. Empty [] disables it. Changed counters or content can produce a new paid snapshot.
